Class Polyline

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.PolylineDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a polyline, which is a series of connected points in 2D space. Provides methods for geometric operations and shape conversions.

Remarks

Points should be provided in counter-clockwise (CCW) order for correct geometric behavior. Use the ReverseOrder() method if your points are in clockwise (CW) order.

ChangeRotation(float)

Rotates the polyline around its centroid by a specified angle in radians.

public void ChangeRotation(float rotRad)

Parameters

rotRad float

The rotation angle in radians.

Remarks

The rotation is applied in-place to all points, using the mean centroid as the origin.

ChangeSize(float)

Changes the length of each vector from the centroid to each point by a specified amount.

public void ChangeSize(float amount)

Parameters

amount float

The amount to change the length of each vector from the centroid.

Remarks

Positive values increase the size, negative values decrease it. The direction of each point from the centroid is preserved.

DrawGappedOutline(float, LineDrawingInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo)

Draws a gapped outline for a polyline (open or closed), creating a dashed or segmented effect along the polyline's length.

public float DrawGappedOutline(float perimeter, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo gapDrawingInfo)

Parameters

perimeter float

The total length of the polyline. If zero or negative, the method calculates it automatically. Providing a known length avoids redundant calculations and improves performance, especially for static segments.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing how to draw the polyline.

gapDrawingInfo GappedOutlineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing the gap configuration.

Returns

float

The perimeter of the polyline if positive; otherwise, -1. If the shape does not change, the valid length can be reused in subsequent frames to avoid recalculating.

Remarks

  • If gapDrawingInfo.Gaps.Gaps is 0 or gapDrawingInfo.GapPerimeterPercentage.GapPerimeterPercentage is 0, the polyline is drawn solid.
  • If gapDrawingInfo.GapPerimeterPercentage.GapPerimeterPercentage is 1 or greater, no polyline is drawn.

DrawGlow(ValueRange, ValueRangeColor, int, float, bool, LineCapType, bool)

Draws the polyline as a layered glow by rendering multiple stroked passes with interpolated thickness and color values.

public void DrawGlow(ValueRange thicknessRange, ValueRangeColor colorRange, int steps, float miterLimit = 2, bool beveled = false, LineCapType capType = LineCapType.CappedExtended, bool useDelaunay = false)

Parameters

thicknessRange ValueRange

The stroke thickness range used from the first pass to the final pass.

colorRange ValueRangeColor

The color range used from the first pass to the final pass.

steps int

The number of glow passes to render. A value of 1 draws a single pass using the maximum thickness and color.

miterLimit float

The maximum miter length factor used for sharp joins before beveling is applied.

beveled bool

If true, sharp joins are beveled instead of using extended miters.

capType LineCapType

The cap style used for the open ends of the polyline.

useDelaunay bool

If true, applies Delaunay refinement when triangulating the stroke mesh.

Remarks

This is useful for soft outlines, energy trails, and other expanding stroke effects.

DrawLinesScaled(LineDrawingInfo, float, float)

Draws the polyline with each side scaled towards its origin, allowing for variable side lengths.

public void DrawLinesScaled(LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, float sideScaleFactor, float sideScaleOrigin = 0.5)

Parameters

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

The drawing information, including thickness, color, and cap type.

sideScaleFactor float

The scale factor for each side.

  • 0: No polyline is drawn.
  • 1: The normal polyline is drawn.
  • 0.5: Each side is half as long.
sideScaleOrigin float

The point along the line to scale from, in both directions (0 to 1).

  • 0: Start of Segment
  • 0.5: Center of Segment
  • 1: End of Segment

Remarks

This method is useful for creating effects where the polyline appears to shrink or grow from its sides.

GetClosestPoint(Circle)

Finds the closest point between this polyline and a Circle.

public ClosestPointResult GetClosestPoint(Circle other)

Parameters

other Circle

The Circle to compare against.

Returns

ClosestPointResult

A ClosestPointResult containing the closest points and related data. Returns a default value if the polyline has fewer than two points.

Remarks

This method iterates through each segment of the polyline and finds the closest point on each segment to the circle. The closest of these is returned as a ClosestPointResult.

Computes one interpolated point along each edge of the polyline and writes the results into result.

Parameters

t float

The interpolation factor used for each edge. Values between 0 and 1 produce points between each vertex and the next vertex.

If the collection contains fewer than two points, the method returns without modifying result.

GetInterpolatedEdgePoints(float, int, Points)

Repeatedly computes interpolated edge points for the polyline and writes the final result into result.

public void GetInterpolatedEdgePoints(float t, int steps, Points result)

Parameters

t float

The interpolation factor used for each edge on every pass. Values between 0 and 1 produce points between each vertex and the next vertex.

steps int

The number of interpolation passes to perform. Values less than or equal to 1 perform a single pass.

result Points

The destination collection that will receive the interpolated points.

Remarks

If the collection contains fewer than two points, the method returns without modifying result.

ReverseOrder()

Reverses the order of points in the polyline. After calling this method, the polyline will be in clockwise (CW) order if it was counter-clockwise (CCW) before and vice versa.

public void ReverseOrder()

ScaleSize(float)

Scales the polyline uniformly about its centroid.

public void ScaleSize(float scale)

Parameters

scale float

The scale factor to apply to all points relative to the centroid.

Remarks

A scale of 1 leaves the polyline unchanged; values greater than 1 enlarge it, and values between 0 and 1 shrink it.

SetPosition(Vector2)

Sets the centroid of the polyline to a new position by translating all points.

public void SetPosition(Vector2 newPosition)

Parameters

newPosition Vector2

The new position for the centroid.

Remarks

This method moves the entire polyline so that its mean centroid matches newPosition.

SetRotation(float)

Sets the absolute rotation of the polyline so that the vector from the centroid to the first point matches the specified angle.

public void SetRotation(float angleRad)

Parameters

angleRad float

The target angle in radians.

Remarks

The polyline is rotated in-place to achieve the desired orientation.

SetSize(float)

Sets the distance from the centroid to each point to a specified value.

public void SetSize(float size)

Parameters

size float

The new distance from the centroid to each point.

Remarks

All points are set to be exactly size units from the centroid, preserving their directions.

ToPolylinePercentage(float, Polyline)

Builds a new open Polyline representing the first portion of this polyline up to the specified fraction of its total length.

public void ToPolylinePercentage(float f, Polyline result)

Parameters

f float

The fraction of the total polyline length to include. Values less than or equal to zero are ignored, and values greater than or equal to one copy the full polyline.

result Polyline

The destination polyline that receives the traced points.

Remarks

This method converts the requested fraction into an absolute length along the polyline, then delegates to ToPolylinePerimeter(float, Polyline).

ToPolylinePerimeter(float, Polyline)

Builds a new open Polyline representing the first portion of this polyline up to the specified traveled distance.

public void ToPolylinePerimeter(float perimeterToDraw, Polyline result)

Parameters

perimeterToDraw float

The distance to trace along the polyline. Values less than or equal to zero are ignored.

result Polyline

The destination polyline that will be cleared and populated with the traced points.

Remarks

The resulting polyline follows the original vertex order from the first point toward the last point and does not wrap. If the requested distance ends in the middle of a segment, an interpolated endpoint is added.

TriangulateOutline(Triangulation, float, float, bool, ShapeClipperEndType, bool)

Triangulates this polyline's stroked outline and writes the generated triangles into the provided Triangulation.

public void TriangulateOutline(Triangulation result, float thickness, float miterLimit = 2, bool beveled = false, ShapeClipperEndType endType = ShapeClipperEndType.Butt, bool useDelaunay = false)

Parameters

result Triangulation

The destination triangulation that receives the generated triangles.

thickness float

The stroke thickness to triangulate.

miterLimit float

The maximum miter length factor used for stroke joins.

beveled bool

Whether joins that exceed the miter limit should be beveled.

endType ShapeClipperEndType

The end-cap style to use for the open polyline.

useDelaunay bool

Whether to apply Delaunay refinement when creating the triangulation.

Remarks

This method triangulates only the stroked outline of the polyline. It does not modify the polyline itself.

TriangulateOutlinePercentage(Triangulation, float, float, float, bool, LineCapType, bool)

Triangulates the stroked outline of a partial section of this polyline, measured as a fraction of its total length, and writes the generated triangles into the provided Triangulation.

public void TriangulateOutlinePercentage(Triangulation result, float f, float thickness, float miterLimit = 2, bool beveled = false, LineCapType capType = LineCapType.CappedExtended, bool useDelaunay = false)

Parameters

result Triangulation

The destination triangulation that receives the generated triangles.

f float

The fraction of the total polyline length to include before triangulating the resulting stroked section.

thickness float

The stroke thickness used to build the outline geometry.

miterLimit float

The maximum miter length factor used for joins between consecutive segments.

beveled bool

Whether joins that exceed the miter limit should fall back to beveled corners.

capType LineCapType

The cap style to use at the open ends of the generated partial stroke.

useDelaunay bool

Whether to apply Delaunay refinement when creating the triangulation.

Remarks

This method does not modify the polyline itself. It delegates to the clipping backend to derive the partial stroke and triangulate it.
